system.description: You can knit back together damaged flesh with a touch. You can reduce a wound by one severity: major to moderate, moderate to minor, or minor to none. Instead of curing a wound, you can enhance a character’s next recovery by +2 Pool points. If used on a living or undead NPC, you restore 3 health. Action.
